== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Shadow]] [[madra]], also known as [[dream madra]] or the [[madra]] of [[Shadow|shadow]] and [[dreams]], is a versatile spiritual energy characterized by its mysterious and difficult-to-define properties. It is considered a natural aspect of [[madra]], similar to [[wind]], and is famously utilized by the [[Akura clan]]. In combat, [[Shadow|shadow]] [[madra]] can be used to create dark auras that cover vast areas, form physical [[constructs]] like blades or hands, and even manifest as illusory images or clones. It is capable of sinking into a target's [[spirit]], causing significant pain and internal damage to both the body and soul. This energy can be blended with other [[aspects]], such as [[dream madra]], to create complex effects like illusory light or difficult-to-detect [[constructs]]. When combined with [[blood madra]], it can form a "[[Blood Shadow]]," a powerful but potentially parasitic entity that feeds on the host's [[spirit]] and [[life essence]]. While some practitioners use it to create formless weapons, others utilize its ability to manipulate darkness and shadows for movement or concealment. The depth of [[Shadow|shadow]] [[madra]] is significant enough that it can be used to create specialized [[Paths]], such as the [[Path]] of Eternal Night.}}
